stories.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
stories.summary: Drone makers are testing new, big drones that can deliver water or fire retardant with AI assistance. Aspen, Colorado is the first place trying them out. Cool and expensive? Yes. Effective? TBD.

stories.title: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
stories.summary: The U.S. has skipped a key U.N. human rights review for the second year running. Rights groups warn the absence risks undermining global accountability.

stories.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
stories.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

stories.title: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
stories.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

stories.title: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
stories.summary: Little is known about her except that she's reportedly about 13 and named Kim Ju Ae, but Korea's spy agency says she's likely her father's heir.

stories.title: Indonesia's VP offers resignation as questions mount over his eligibility
stories.summary: His resignation offer comes amid a widening political rift between Prabowo and Widodo and a separate investigation into allegations that senior police officials wiretapped the president.

stories.title: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
stories.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

stories.title: Seven days of chaos in the ER: How this country's healthcare system is unraveling
stories.summary: Renewed fighting has pushed Ethiopia's healthcare system close to collapse: "The whole emergency (room) was flooded with war trauma patients," one surgeon says of a brutal week in September.

stories.title: Get in, loser: Broadway's newest 'Mean Girls' are ready to insult (and enlighten) you
stories.summary: "School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play," is ending a Broadway run this week and celebrating with livestream broadcasts. We interviewed the Tony-nominated playwright, Jocelyn Bioh.

stories.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
stories.summary: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.
